title: Assetto Corsa
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine sikarugir-10.0_6, Highball 0.7.18, macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), 2026-09-02; first verified on macOS 14.6 with Highball 0.7.10, 2026-08-28. Measured driving at Laguna Seca in the Ferrari 458 cockpit, 1728x1117, D3DMetal (Game Porting Toolkit 3.0, D3D11): GPU 7.6 ms of an 8.9 ms frame with 1447 draws, so it is GPU-bound and healthy rather than CPU-starved. Measured 2026-09-10 on a fresh install with .NET Framework 4.8 installed. Reported by Dhruv9449 (highball-db#379, 2026-10-07), Apple M1 Max, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, D3DMetal with the recipe's .NET 4.8, rated 5 of 5 after 36 minutes of driving, the first driven session on r21 and macOS 27.
notes: Works end to end with two things in place: install the .NET Framework 4.8 dependency first (bottle settings → Dependencies; took 6 minutes here on 2026-09-02, can take 20-40 and looks frozen — let it finish), and use the D3DMetal renderer. The stock launcher is a 32-bit .NET/WPF app: without .NET it dies silently, which was the long-standing 'AC won't launch' failure (re-confirmed 2026-09-02: on a bottle whose registry claimed 4.8 but only had Wine Mono, the launcher died with a Mono TypeLoadException on CEF3; after the real dotnet48 install it rendered fully). Re-verified on macOS 26.6.2, 2026-09-02, D3DMetal: launcher intro movie and main menu render, a practice session (Ferrari 458 at Laguna Seca) loads and runs at 127-128 fps at 1728x1117 (Metal HUD). On macOS 14.6 (2026-08-28) sessions ran at 150-170 fps fullscreen with a clean exit. DXMT: on macOS 14.6 it black-screened the session (engine runs, never paints); on macOS 26.6.2 (2026-09-02) the same session rendered and drove under DXMT 0.80 at 69-136 fps, so the black screen looks tied to the older OS. If you get a black screen on session start, switch the bottle to D3DMetal, stop all bottle processes, and relaunch. Launcher news panels may spin forever; cosmetic. Re-checked on 2026-10-05 on an M4 with engine r21 (DEP kept on): without .NET 4.8 the launcher dies on Mono's CEF3 load as described; the recipe installs .NET 4.8 and the launcher then opens on its language screen. No session was driven in that run.

dxmt.detail: macOS 26.6.2 (2026-09-02): session renders and was driven, one lap logged, 69-136 fps at 1728x1117, clean exit. macOS 14.6 (2026-08-28): black screen on session start (engine runs, never paints).

knownIssues.symptom: The launcher (AssettoCorsa.exe, .NET/WPF) shows 'Configuration system failed to initialize' and exits; the game itself never starts from Steam's Play.
knownIssues.cause: Reproduced 2026-09-04 on M1 Pro / macOS 26.6.2 with .NET 4.8 installed: System.Configuration rejects machine.config line 6 ('Section names beginning with config are reserved', the standard configProtectedData section) — a .NET-configuration-init-under-Wine failure affecting every .NET app in that bottle; machine.config itself is valid. Engine-independent (same on Wine 10 and our Wine 11 build).
knownIssues.fix: The game binary works: launching acs.exe directly (with steam_appid.txt = 244210, Steam running, D3DMetal) starts the sim. A launcher-bypass pin is the practical route until the .NET config init is fixed.

knownIssues.symptom: acs.exe exits immediately with no error and no log when started directly.
knownIssues.cause: the game needs Steam's app identity, which Steam sets when you press Play. Without SteamAppId=244210 in the environment it quits before it initialises anything, which looks like a broken game rather than a missing variable.
knownIssues.fix: launch it from Steam, or from Highball's Play, which is what sets it. Only relevant to launching the executable by hand.

knownIssues.symptom: On D3DMetal the session dies on Start with a Metal assertion, a texture of width and height 4294967295 (reported on a 13-inch M1 with 8 GB, macOS 26.6.2, highball#94)
knownIssues.cause: measured from the reporter's video.ini (highball#94): SHADOW_MAP_SIZE=-1, which the launcher writes when Shadows is set to off, becomes a shadow texture of size 4294967295 on D3DMetal and Metal refuses it. Mirror and cubemap SIZE=0 are the same class of value
knownIssues.fix: confirmed by the reporter (highball#94): in the launcher's Options, Video set Shadows to Low or higher (SHADOW_MAP_SIZE 1024 or 2048 in cfg/video.ini) and give Mirrors and Reflections a size (512 here), then the session starts on a 13-inch M1 with 8 GB

verified.fps: launcher reached, no session driven this run
verified.how: Steam copy through Highball on an M4 on 2026-10-05, engine r21, D3DMetal: without the recipe the launcher dies on Wine's Mono (TypeLoadException on CEF3), as documented; after the recipe installed .NET Framework 4.8 the launcher opens on its language screen.
